#   - Propeller-wing and propeller-pylon interaction effects
#   - Aerodynamic and aeroacoustic measurements
#   - Tests in open-jet and closed-section low-speed wind tunnels
# The PDF is also partially damaged (xref table errors) which prevented
# full text extraction from many pages.
# POSSIBLE BEAVER PROPELLER SOURCES (require manual search)
# The "Beaver propeller" may refer to:
# 1. De Havilland Canada DHC-2 Beaver propeller test data
# 2. A specific model propeller used in academic research
# 3. A propeller tested at a specific wind tunnel facility
# Suggested search paths:
# - NASA NTRS: search for "Beaver propeller" or "DHC-2 propeller performance"
# - AIAA Arc: search for propeller test data with "Beaver" designation
# - UIUC Propeller Database: check for Beaver-type propellers
# - Contact TU Delft Aerospace Engineering for thesis data supplements
# PLACEHOLDER FORMAT (for when data is digitized)
# Expected format for forward-flight propeller data:
# J
# (advance ratio

#   J  = V_inf / (n * D)          advance ratio

#   CP = P / (rho * n^3 * D^5)    power coefficient
#   eta = J * CT / (2*pi * CQ)    propulsive efficiency
#   CQ = Q / (rho * n^2 * D^5)    torque coefficient
